name: draft-class-generator
description: Generate importable Madden 26 draft classes (`.mdc`) from real NFL draft history (1936–2026), with player ratings derived from Pro-Football-Reference **weighted Approximate Value (wAV)**. AFL+NFL drafts are merged for 1960–1969, veteran free agents can be injected, and players are cached.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.app:build: npm run dev:server:build && npm run dev:web:build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist
scripts.app:build:m26: npm run dev:server:build && npm run dev:web:build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:m26
scripts.app:build:m27: npm run dev:server:build && npm run dev:web:build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:m27
scripts.app:publish: npm run dev:server:build && npm run dev:web:build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run publish:m26 && npm run publish:m27 && cd .. && node scripts/publish-release.mjs
